design: Same bounded repo and archive tools for both arms; treatment alone gets an initially empty L3 Memex store and the standard project AGENTS.md generated by the Memex Codex adapter. Each arm has two fresh ephemeral Codex processes, retaining its isolated repo, archive and treatment store across processes. Prior real user messages and the arm first-session response are available in the archive. No per-task instruction requires a memory call.
evaluation: Check both initial defects before runs, fixed sandbox tests after runs, explicit write/search/open events and citation use, blinded AI reviews, all failures, reported tokens and actual cost gaps.
limits: adaptive rerun after an unexpected connector in the first attempt; the bridge task was already attempted
two related tasks are not an independent 30-task production study
one bridge defect arose in new code written for this work
user history is selected and clipped
Codex ChatGPT subscription charges are not individually observable
